about: P68 live check: 2 P68 dev sentences of the game through the AI version on the eval ledger (evals/play/p61/shots.mjs serve, VERCEL_ENV=production, astra as reader and director). quick = the quick game, reading = the game after reading (only when the reading picks another genre), ai = the director's AI version.

rows.sentence: a first-person ride in a mine cart on rails, turning to shoot the bats that swoop at you in the dark tunnels
rows.note: One director call (48 097 prompt tokens) spent all 8 000 output tokens on reasoning, so the answer was empty/cut and the AI version ended MALFORMED. The player keeps the reading game: railfps, enemy 'bat' x10, but target 'mine cart' and hero 'first-person ride' (the same hero as the quick game).

rows.sentence: sit in a tour jeep that follows the jungle road on its own and fire at the angry monkeys throwing coconuts at you
rows.note: One director call (190 reasoning tokens). The AI version stays railfps ('Angry Monkey Range'): enemy 'angry monkey' x10 and a boss of the same kind, but the target is the ride ('tour jeep') and the hero 'monkey' as in the quick game (adds: []).

caps: shots.mjs serve --cap-usd 0.3 --director-cap-usd 1.2 (R9 budget 1.5 USD; the ledger book is per process, R7 spent 1.81 USD of the 5 USD eval cap before).
